decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The English cue and sense are correct, and both Malay forms are semantically valid. However, presenting “meter letak kereta” as the distinct Malaysian common word with relation “different-common-word” is potentially misleading: Malaysian official and dictionary sources also use or recognize “meter parkir,” while “meter letak kereta” is an established formal/preferred term. No false-friend contrast is supported. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
